models_evaluated: MBDS-based logistic regression mortality model for ischaemic stroke

links.outcome: AUC of original model on temporally later external cohort versus recalibrated model
links.effect: External validation AUC 0.726 vs recalibrated AUC 0.743; external validation slightly decreased AUC but confirmed validity of baseline model.
links.quote: Rigorous external validation slightly decreased the AUC but confirmed the validity of the baseline model for the chronologically later cohort.

links.outcome: Discrimination after recalibrating model coefficients on later cohort
links.effect: Recalibrated model produced AUC of 0.743 compared with 0.726 for external validation using original coefficients.
links.quote: The recalibrated model produced an AUC of 0.743 and was composed of the following variables: age (odds ratio, OR:1.073), female sex (OR:1.143), ischaemic heart disease (OR:1.192), hypertension (OR:0.719), atrial fibrillation (OR:1.414), hyperlipidaemia (OR:0.652), heart failure (OR:2.133) and posterior circulation stroke (OR: 0.755).
